title: Climb Yaxhá above twin jungle lakes
description: Walk a forested Maya city where causeways link plazas and temples above two lakes.

title: See living Maya ceremony at Iximché
description: Explore the Kaqchikel capital and respect any ceremonies taking place at its active sacred altar.

title: Read the carved stories at Quiriguá

title: Trace two cultures at Tak’alik Ab’aj
description: Walk terraces and monuments showing the long transition between Olmec and Maya traditions.

title: Find an ancient city inside modern Guatemala City

title: Canoe Crooked Tree’s wetland at birding pace

title: Stand beneath Nim Li Punit’s tall carved stelae
description: Explore a southern Maya site known for a plaza of carved stone monuments.

title: Hike from Maya mounds to Bocawina waterfalls

title: Walk the short jungle trail at Billy Barquedier

title: Hike El Imposible with a community guide
description: Use the park’s local guides for forest trails, viewpoints and river crossings.

title: Pair civil-war history with the hill above Perquín

title: Walk the living collections at Lancetilla

title: See ancient deposits inside the Talgua Caves

title: Walk the old cemeteries of Greytown

title: Boat into Los Guatuzos wetlands

title: Hike to La Estanzuela’s dark-rock cascade
description: Follow the community reserve trail to a waterfall where guided climbing may be offered.

title: Trace pre-Columbian engineering at Guayabo
description: Walk marked trails past stone roads, mounds and still-functioning waterworks.

title: Descend into Barra Honda with a park guide
description: Reserve the guided descent into a limestone cave and stay within the park’s strict group limits.

title: Walk the dry-forest shore at Bahía Junquillal
description: Explore a managed coastal refuge of dry forest, beach and calm coves.

title: Explore Las Baulas beyond the surf towns
description: Visit the marine park’s beach and estuary habitats, following current ranger controls.

title: Hike the seasonal forest of Diriá
description: Walk a small inland national park protecting transition forest and headwater streams.

title: Walk Panamá’s recovering salt-flat landscape
description: Choose a marked trail through arid salt flats, dry forest and archaeological traces.

title: Hike between Alto de Piedra’s waterfalls
description: Follow an undeveloped forest route to a chain of cascades near Santa Fe.

title: Join a managed turtle watch on Isla Cañas

title: Walk the Panamanian side of La Amistad

title: Climb the Balcony of Iberia trail
description: Follow a demanding park trail through wet forest to a high plateau and waterfall.

title: Row through Taco Bay’s mangroves

title: Meet eastern Cuba’s natural history in Gibara
description: Visit the small local museum’s rooms on birds, reptiles, geology and marine life.

title: Explore Tanque Azul with a qualified local operator
description: Use a specialist operator for the flooded cave system in the Caletones reserve.

title: Travel the far-east road to Punta de Maisí
description: Follow a locally arranged excursion to Cuba’s eastern tip, its lighthouse and coastal viewpoints.

title: Walk Holywell’s Oatley Mountain Trail
description: Take the one-hour forest circuit past several mountain viewpoints.

title: Explore Cockpit Country with Maroon guides
description: Join a community guide to learn how limestone caves shaped Maroon resistance and rural life.

title: Hike and eat with the Bunker’s Hill community
description: Walk to forest caves, hear local and Maroon history, and share traditionally prepared food.

title: Read Jamaica’s layered history at Seville
description: Explore the great house collection and grounds spanning Indigenous, Spanish, British and African histories.

title: Follow cacao from farm to chocolate in Canducito

title: Explore Dominican folk culture at Centro León
description: Use the permanent galleries to connect music, visual art and everyday Dominican identity.

title: Walk the cascades of Saltos de Jima
description: Follow the protected riverside trail through forest to a chain of cascades, checking conditions locally.

title: Walk Clifton’s Lucayan, Loyalist and African landscapes
description: Follow trails through ruins, dunes, wetlands and the remains of enslaved community life.

title: Walk Eleuthera’s native-plant trails
description: Explore interpreted trails focused on Bahamian plants, bush medicine and coppice habitats.

title: Watch flamingos with an Inagua guide
description: Arrange local transport and guiding to observe the island’s protected flamingo habitat.

title: Learn community conservation at Casa Pueblo
place: Casa Pueblo and Bosque del Pueblo
description: Visit the community cultural centre, then arrange access to the forest it helped protect.

title: Tour Hacienda Buena Vista’s water-powered works
description: Reserve a guided visit to the restored coffee estate and its historic hydraulic machinery.

title: Enter Nariva Swamp with a wetland guide
description: Arrange an appointment-based visit for wetland birds and other wildlife without sighting guarantees.

title: Walk Lopinot’s cocoa house and village trails
description: Explore the estate’s cocoa house, bridge and paths while confronting its plantation history.

title: Read the sugar landscape at Morgan Lewis Mill
description: Visit the windmill exterior and equipment exhibit, checking restoration access before setting out.

title: Land on Maria Major with an authorised guide
description: Join a National Trust boat visit; independent landing is prohibited and nesting closures may apply.

title: Learn cassava and Creole traditions at Fond Latisab
description: Join a locally hosted cultural visit centred on foodways, music and traditional skills.

title: Make Grenadian chocolate from tree to bar
description: Prebook the small-group workshop that follows cocoa from propagation and drying to chocolate.

title: Read Carriacou’s island history in its community museum
description: Visit the locally run collection on archaeology, seafaring, crafts and island traditions.

title: Swim inside Owia’s lava-rock pool
description: Visit the Atlantic-edge pool only in settled conditions and follow local safety advice.

title: Look for the Saint Vincent parrot on Vermont trail
description: Use the managed forest trail quietly for a chance, never a promise, of seeing the endemic parrot.

title: Confront plantation history at Betty’s Hope
description: Walk the restored mill and ruins while learning about the enslaved people who powered the estate.

title: Hike Wallings with its community custodians
description: Use the community reserve’s forest trails and current local route guidance.

title: Listen for parrots on the Syndicate trail
description: Walk the short forest loop quietly for a chance, never a promise, of seeing endemic parrots.

title: Tour Kalinago Barana Autê with a community guide
description: Learn about structures, crafts and foodways through interpretation by Kalinago hosts.

title: Trace water, labour and rock art at Wingfield
description: Walk the estate yard to see its unusual aqueduct and nearby rock carving, with local interpretation.

title: Tour Fairview’s house and volcanic-stone bath
description: Visit the restored great house and garden while keeping enslaved plantation labour central to the story.

title: Follow aloe from field to factory in Hato
description: Take the guided plantation, museum and factory visit to understand Aruba’s aloe industry.

title: Walk San Nicolas with the mural curator
description: Join a small guided walk explaining the artists and stories behind the town’s street gallery.

title: Hear many voices at Savonet Museum
description: Explore audiovisual and object-based accounts of Indigenous, enslaved and later communities.

title: Walk the Cathedral of Thorns labyrinth
description: Book a guided visit to Herman van Bergen’s thorn-built art labyrinth and performance space.

title: Walk Grand Cayman’s old-growth Mastic Trail
description: Use the National Trust trail through inland forest for endemic birds and reptiles.

title: Meet Cayman’s blue-iguana recovery programme
description: Take the managed conservation tour at the botanic park rather than treating wildlife as a photo prop.

title: Read Cheshire Hall beyond its stone ruins
description: Use a guided heritage visit to understand Loyalist cotton production and enslaved labour.

title: Walk Wade’s Green with historical context
description: Explore surviving plantation structures while centring the lives and labour of enslaved people.

title: Walk Virgin Gorda’s Cornish copper ruins
description: Explore engine-house and chimney remains on exposed coastal cliffs, keeping clear of shafts.

title: Find Tortola’s last windmill at Mount Healthy
description: Visit the compact park and view plantation-era mill remains with appropriate historical context.

title: Learn Crucian traditions at Estate Whim
description: Tour the great house and grounds, then seek living-history demonstrations by local tradition bearers.

title: Paddle Salt River Bay after dark
description: Use a permitted local operator for a low-light paddle and follow conditions and park guidance.

title: Step inside early Bermuda at Carter House
description: Visit the small museum, settler-cabin reconstruction and native garden during published opening days.

title: Walk Spittal Pond’s nature and freedom trail
description: Follow the reserve paths to coastal geology and Jeffrey’s Cave, tied to an enslaved man’s escape.

title: Hike La Soufrière from Saint-Claude
description: Check volcano, weather and trail notices before climbing the marked summit route.

title: Study slavery and its legacies at Mémorial ACTe
description: Explore interpretation of the slave trade, slavery and their abolitions.

title: Walk the wind-cut Pointe des Châteaux
description: Take the signed coastal path and keep back from exposed cliff edges and surf.

title: Cross to Fort Napoléon above Terre-de-Haut
description: Visit the fort museum and grounds after confirming ferry and opening times.

title: Explore Grande Rivière valley below La Grivelière

title: Climb Mount Pelée by the Aileron route
description: Start early, check mountain weather and use the established volcanic trail.

title: Cross the canopy bridges at Jardin de Balata
description: Walk tropical collections arranged around a Creole house, including elevated canopy bridges.

title: Tour Habitation Clément’s house, art and rum heritage
description: Explore the restored house, former distillery, gardens and contemporary-art programme.

title: Cross the arid Savane des Pétrifications

title: Walk Domaine d’Émeraude’s interpreted forest
description: Choose a short interpreted forest circuit and visit the pavilion on island biodiversity.

title: Cross to Musée Archipélitude on Île aux Marins
description: Cross in season to see island customs and traditional skills interpreted in the old school and preserved houses.

title: Trace island life at Musée Héritage
description: Explore ten rooms on local social, religious, medical, school and fishing history during the museum’s summer season.

title: Walk the headlands of Cap de Miquelon
description: Follow the marked coastal route with clothing for fast-changing North Atlantic weather.

title: Follow the marked trail to Anse à Henry
description: Use the well-marked coastal trail and its rest benches, checking wind and ground conditions.

title: Walk the Grand Barachois lagoon with a nature guide
description: Join the seasonal small-group walk for shorebirds and seals viewed at respectful distance.
